Alice K: Morning — nightly eval alerted a big F1 drop for rdx-neo-1.0-int8 on promptset sql_v2. Saw 0.92 -> 0.62. tagging @Jamal @Priya @Tom to triage.

eval-bot: nightly-eval: model=rdx-neo-1.0-int8, promptset=sql_v2, metric=f1, baseline=0.921, current=0.623, delta=-0.298 :warning:

Jamal R: what changed last night on the int8 build path? any quant pipeline tweaks?

Alice K: we had two merges during the midnight window: (A) tokenizer v2 that preserves Unicode curly quotes (stopped normalizing to ASCII) and (B) a quant-cli refactor that altered special-token handling (flattened special tokens into vocab indices).

Priya S: I pulled failing examples. short repro: prompt contains curly single quotes around numeric IDs and model returns escaped/quoted results instead of raw values. snippet: 
```
Prompt: "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = ‘123’ LIMIT 1;"
Expected: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = 123;
Model out: "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = \"123\"; -- returned as string"
```

Priya S: looks like tokenizer treats the curly quote as a distinct token and model generation wraps values in string tokens.

Tom L: can you paste tokenization ids old vs new for the example?

Priya S: sure — ran both tokenizers locally:
```
# tokenizer v2 (preserve unicode)
tokenize("SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = ‘123’ LIMIT 1;") -> [101, 523, 11, 900, 44, 2003, 17, 987, 304, 4001]

# tokenizer v1 (ascii-normalize)
tokenize("SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = '123' LIMIT 1;") -> [101, 523, 11, 900, 44, 2003, 17, 987, 304, 4001]
```

Priya S: small prompts show same ids, but when we include special/system tokens the offsets diverge.

Alice K: Jamal — your refactor touched how we assign embedding offsets for special tokens, right?

Jamal R: yes. I changed the mapping to inline special tokens into the main vocab instead of reserving indices 0..n. The assumption was tokenizer indices are stable. With v2 some special tokens shifted and conversion wrote embeddings to wrong rows.

Tom L: that explains a lot — embedding-row shift for sentinel tokens can produce wrong KV cache usage in early layers, which cascades as bad decoding for numeric/text formatting.

Priya S: reproduction steps I used: 1) checkout rdx-neo-1.0 commit X; 2) enable tokenizer v2; 3) quant-cli --mode=int8 --preserve-special=false; 4) run eval harness on sql_v2. Failure reproduces only when both changes present.

Jamal R: confirmed. If I run quant conversion with --preserve-special=true (legacy mapping) the produced artifact matches baseline mapping and metrics stay stable.

Alice K: quick root-cause draft:
- Trigger: concurrent changes (tokenizer v2 + quant-cli flattening) deployed in the same window.
- Mechanism: special-token index reordering during int8 conversion + tokenizer unicode-preserve edge cases produces mismatched embedding lookups.
- Symptom: SQL prompt outputs wrapped/escaped values and formatting errors causing F1 drop.

Tom L: mitigation plan (short list):
- Hotfix: revert the flattening change on the int8 path (fast rollback).
- Interim: re-enable preserve-special mapping in the quant pipeline + assert checks.
- Tests: add tokenizer-id-stability test to nightly evals comparing token ids across normalization modes.
- Policy: any tokenizer or quant mapping change must include a token-index stability report in PRs.

Priya S: I'll add a small promptset mutation file that includes curly quotes and other unicode punctuation so we cover these edge cases. ETA EOD.

Jamal R: rolling revert now for int8 conversions. will post build id in this thread when ready. ETA ~2h.

eval-bot: deploy-notice: hotfix build queued: rdx-int8-hotfix-2026-03-20-02 queued by Jamal R

Alice K: I'll run a focused canary once hotfix is up: sql_v2 + a handful of critical promptsets. If they pass, we promote; if not, rollback further. I'll post results here.

Tom L: I'm drafting the PR checklist entry for tokenizer/quant changes and will include the token-id stability check and a gating requirement for special-token diffs. ETA EOD.

Alice K: action items recap:
- Jamal: revert flattening on int8 + push hotfix (ETA 2h)
- Priya: add tokenizer-consistency test + curly-quote promptset mutation (ETA EOD)
- Alice: run canary and report back (after hotfix)
- Tom: add PR checklist entry and gating rule (ETA EOD)

Priya S: small note: we'll also want a CI assert in the quant conversion that compares embedding checksums for reserved index ranges to prevent silent reindexing.

Jamal R: hotfix build started, id will follow.

Alice K: thanks all. we'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for the rollback -> canary -> promote flow. planning a short postmortem once actions are closed. :thumbsup:
